No, we don't offer direct exchanges. Instead, you'd return the 8-inch pot and place a new order for the 10-inch one.

To return it, start from "My Orders" within **30 days** of delivery. The pot must be unused and in its original packaging. A prepaid label is emailed to you, and it expires after **7 days**, so drop the parcel off within that window.

Since this would be a change-of-mind return, a flat **$6.95** is deducted from your refund (free for Leafy Plus members). Your refund goes to your original payment method within **5 business days** of the pot reaching our warehouse.
